title: Casio Men Digital Watch AE-1700H-1AVDF
description:
A multifunctional digital watch with wide, easy-read display and rotating bezel — perfect for the sports scene.

Water-resistant up to 100 meters, ten-year battery life, LED backlight, as well as handy features like stopwatch, alarm, and more.
features: World time: Dual time Daylight saving on/off
Alarm/hourly time signal:  Multi-function alarms 3 independent multi-function alarms (2 one-time alarms and 1 snooze/one-time alarm) Alarm type: Daily alarm, date alarm, 1-month alarm,
LED backlight Selectable illumination duration (1.5 seconds or 3 seconds), afterglow
Mute feature: Button operation tone on/off
Other features:Fishing mode The suitability of a specific date and time for fishing is indicated as one of four levels.
